note: Answers copied directly from stage6-questions.json's expectedAnswer field. Fraction answers use a consistent standard form (reduced, positive denominator) throughout. rn-q09, rn-q10 and rn-q17 ask the student to name a property in words — a real student could phrase this correctly but differently (e.g. 'commutative property of addition' instead of 'Commutativity of addition') and be marked wrong. This is the same pre-existing exact-match limitation already documented in linear-equations/answer-keys.json, data-handling/answer-keys.json and understanding-quadrilaterals/answer-keys.json, not something introduced or fixable here.
